item.title: Birdwatching Goose Sorry I'm Late Saw a Warbler
item.description: A silly white goose peers through binoculars with the perfect excuse: sorry I'm late, saw a warbler. A funny gift for birders, bird nerds and anyone who stops mid-walk to spot a bird. Available on stickers, t-shirts and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Unhinged Backyard Chicken Free Range Worm Thief
item.description: A fluffy chicken struts past with wild eyes and a stolen worm in its beak, proudly free range and fully unhinged. It suits chicken keepers and backyard flock lovers and makes a funny gift. Available on stickers, mugs and tote bags. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Silly Goose Birdwatching Through Binoculars Birder Humor
item.description: A white goose peers through binoculars, out birdwatching while being a bird itself. Perfect for birders and bird nerds, it makes a funny gift for anyone who loves a silly goose. Available on stickers, t-shirts and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.
